title.description: Plain, specific headline. Maximum 70 characters — hard limit, the display typeface breaks past it.

slug.description: URL slug: lowercase, hyphenated, no stop words where avoidable.

excerpt.description: Standfirst shown under the headline. One or two sentences, 140-200 characters.

key_points.description: The answer, before the essay. Most readers want only this.

sections.description: Article body. Vary the number and shape between articles — do not use a fixed skeleton.

body.description: Markdown. Paragraphs, lists and bold permitted. No headings inside — use a new section.

when_to_seek_care.description: REQUIRED. Specific thresholds — durations, measurable changes, symptom combinations. Generic advice to 'see a doctor if concerned' is a failure. Markdown list permitted.

faq.description: Optional. Real questions people ask about this, drawn from search. Feeds FAQPage schema.

sources.description: At least 3. Only sources actually used, each supporting a claim actually made.

publisher.description: e.g. NHS, Mayo Clinic, BMJ, CDC
